script: Gifting a Japanese person exactly four items is a brutal insult. The Japanese word for the number four sounds exactly like the word for death. If you hand a friend a wrapped box containing exactly four sweets, you are handing them a physical symbol of death. This unwritten rule is so strict that traditional department stores only sell teacups in sets of five. You must also never carry a potted plant into a hospital room, because the growing roots physically mean the sickness will stay planted in the patient's bed. But the craziest part? You can ruin a safe gift just by tying the ribbon into a normal bow. Because a standard bow is easily retied, handing a looped ribbon to a sick person physically signals that you want them to return to the hospital.
